trash_batch_delete_body: This permanently deletes the {count} selected photos and their files. This cannot be undone.

archive_done: Archived {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}.
unarchive_done: Unarchived {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}.
admin_users_disable_body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you re-enable the account.

user_delete_transfer: Transfer the photos to another member
user_delete_transfer_note: Photos and albums change hands together; the timeline continues.
user_delete_trash: Move the photos to the trash

user_delete_confirm_body: {name}'s account will be deleted for good, and the photos go the way you picked.
user_last_admin: The instance's last administrator cannot be deleted.
user_transfer_to_self: The receiving account must be another member.
admin_models_note: The machine learning models this instance runs: detection, recognition, semantic search and text reading. Each slot can swap onto the official list or an imported model; the download sources live at the page footer.
admin_models_empty_body: The default model group has not been downloaded. Face detection, face recognition, semantic search and text recognition stay off until it lands.
admin_models_download_queued: Waiting for the download to start…
admin_models_download_failed_run: The download failed. Try again to rejoin the run; its own retries may recover it.
admin_models_wiped_notice: Activated with the vector dimension changed from {from} to {to}: {count} embeddings were removed. Rerun the embeddings to rebuild them.
admin_models_rerun_title: Rerun this model over the library?
admin_models_rerun_body: One background run redoes {slot} for every ready image with the active model. Follow it on the task panel.
models_param_min_score_hint: Faces below this score never enter the library
models_param_cluster_hint: Embeddings closer than this belong to one person
admin_jobs_note: The instance's background runs, newest first.
admin_jobs_cancelled: Cancelled. The {count} finished items are kept.
admin_jobs_queued_waiting: Waiting for the run ahead to finish.

admin_jobs_reason_items: {count, plural, one {# item could not be processed.} other {# items could not be processed.}} The server log has the reason.
admin_jobs_reason_stopped: The run stopped before it got through its work. The server log has the reason.
admin_jobs_reason_model_missing: {slot} has no downloaded model. Finish the download on the models page, then retry.
admin_jobs_stop_requested: Stop requested. It stops after the asset it is working on; the work already done stays.
admin_jobs_stop_failed: The stop could not be recorded.
admin_jobs_run_note: A pause affects only the jobs after it -- the one already running finishes.
admin_jobs_run_concurrency_hint: Light = 1 · Standard = half the cores · Full = all but one
admin_jobs_run_nightly_hint: The heavy work (rebuilds, transcodes, model recomputation) runs only inside the window
admin_jobs_run_save_failed: The save did not land. Check the connection and try again.
admin_settings_storage_note: The template every new upload renders its file placement from. The sample line shows where a sample photo lands.
admin_settings_saved_note: Saved. New uploads follow the new layout; existing files never move.
admin_settings_contract_note: Changing the template only affects uploads from the next one on: files already stored keep their paths, and nothing ever moves. Album variables stay empty for direct uploads.
albums_empty_body: Gather a trip or an occasion into an album.
albums_detail_empty_title: This album has no photos yet

albums_timeline_note: Keep this album's photos out of your aggregated timeline.
albums_deletable_note: Off keeps the source files untouched — file-system deletions stay yours to manage.
albums_excluded_notice: This album's photos stay out of your timeline.
albums_cover_body: Pick {count} photos -- the order you click is the order they show. Leave it empty for the weekly rotation.
albums_cover_empty: This album has no photos yet.
albums_cover_invalid: {count} of the picked photos are no longer in the album -- pick again.

albums_create_readonly: The album was created. This folder is read-only — its photos cannot be deleted through the app.
albums_path_hint: Choose an existing folder — the album references it in place; nothing is copied or moved. Typing suggests folders.
albums_path_required: Pick the source folder — an absolute path, like /Volumes/Photos.
albums_path_completion_failed: Could not load the folder suggestions. Check the spelling, or try again.
albums_audience_failed: Could not load the member list.
albums_rescan_failed: Rescan finished with some entries it could not resolve.

memories_create_report: The memory was created. {count, plural, one {# requested member was} other {# requested members were}} not added.
memories_detail_empty_title: This memory has no photos yet
memories_detail_empty_body: Select photos on the wall and add them to this memory.
memories_picker_intro: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} selected — pick a memory, or create one.
memories_picker_skip_note: {count, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} not visible right now and stayed out — a shared photo's visibility is re-checked at add time.
people_empty: Photos with faces will show up here.
people_unnamed_empty: Face clusters appear here once faces are grouped.

people_detach_dialog_body: {name}'s face goes back to not grouped yet — the photo itself is unaffected, and it can be assigned again later.
people_detach_done: Face removed; it is back among the not grouped yet.
people_select_person_body: Who does this face belong to? Pick an existing person, or create a new person from this face.
people_create_from_face: Create a new person from this face
people_create_from_face_done: Created a new person from this face.
person_unname_done: Name removed; this person is unnamed again.
person_delete_body: This deletes {name} and the detection records of all {count} of their faces. The photos themselves are not affected. This cannot be undone.
viewer_assign_body: Pick the person this face belongs to.
viewer_assign_note: This names the whole group: every face grouped with this one shares the name.

settings_password_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
settings_appearance_note: The interface language applies immediately. The installed languages are listed; contributing a translation adds more.
settings_download_note: Batch and whole-album downloads are packaged according to these preferences. Photos are always included, and a Live Photo’s motion always rides along — this switch only decides whether an Android-style motion photo, whose original already carries its motion, also gets the extracted video as a file of its own.
settings_devices_note: A signed-out device needs to sign in again.
admin_settings_trash_note: Deleted photos enter the trash and are permanently deleted once the retention expires. Set 0 to delete immediately.
admin_settings_trash_saved: Saved. The next expiry run applies the new window.
admin_settings_trash_warning: Expired photos are permanently deleted together with their thumbnails and derivatives — this cannot be undone.
admin_settings_transcode_note: Uploaded videos are transcoded into a browser-friendly format. The original file is kept.
admin_settings_transcode_preset_off: No transcoding — store the original only
admin_settings_transcode_keep: Keep the original downloadable when transcoding fails
admin_settings_transcode_saved: Saved. Newly uploaded videos follow the new profile.
admin_settings_transcode_contract: Changing these settings only affects newly uploaded videos; existing transcoded copies are never regenerated.
person_birthdate_dialog_note: The birth date works out this person's age when a photo was taken.
person_avatar_dialog_body: Pick one of this person's faces as their avatar.
person_wall_empty_title: This person's photos are not here yet
person_wall_empty: Photos with this person's face land here.
person_avatar_option: Use this face as the avatar
unreachable_body: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
unreachable_footnote: The address may be incomplete, or the share may have been withdrawn.
trash_remaining_days_label: {name}, {count, plural, =0 {expiring soon} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
places_map_tiles_unconfigured: No tile source configured — set one in the admin settings; pins stay available.
places_map_tiles_unavailable: Tiles unavailable — check the network or the source; pins stay available.
places_map_summary: {cities, plural, one {# city} other {# cities}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · {countries, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}}
admin_settings_update_note: Checks the release feed for a newer version. Only the version number is compared — no photos, no library details and no instance identifier leave your server.
admin_settings_update_failed_note: A feed that cannot be reached stays quiet — nothing turns red, nothing pops up. Check now retries right away.
admin_settings_update_unknown: Last checked {when} · couldn't reach the release feed
admin_settings_update_not_automatic: This only tells you a newer release exists — nothing is downloaded, installed or restarted for you. Upgrade by pulling the new image tag and restarting, or by following the release notes for a manual migration.
admin_settings_update_contract: The server asks the feed for its newest release and reads the tag. The request carries no photo, no library information and no instance identifier; private and loopback addresses are refused and redirects are never followed. A failed check stays quiet.
admin_settings_tiles_note: The browser loads the base map straight from this source; the server never fetches or proxies a tile. The pins come from your own library.
admin_settings_tiles_saved: Saved. The map picks it up on its next load.
admin_settings_tiles_contract: A style document (vector tiles with their layers) or a TileJSON descriptor (raster tiles) both work; the host must allow cross-origin reads. Leave it empty and the map draws its pins over a stated missing base layer. The README lists self-hosting and mirror options.
admin_settings_models_note: The first download is always your own act. This switch covers the other case: a slot whose model is configured but whose files are gone — a wiped model store — fills itself, so the AI jobs resume instead of failing.
admin_settings_models_saved: Saved. It applies to the next AI job.
admin_settings_models_contract: A failed download keeps the job's ordinary failure: the run shows as failed in the task list and can be retried from the models page. Weights are pinned by checksum and fetched from the configured mirror when one is set.
admin_settings_image_note: The image derivatives: the grid thumbnail, the viewer preview, and the on-demand full-size copy. The original is always kept.
admin_settings_image_preview_1080: 1080 px — default, lighter on the wire
admin_settings_image_format_avif: AVIF — smaller on disk, slower to encode
admin_settings_image_format_webp: WebP — faster to encode, a little larger
admin_settings_image_format_hint: On a weak machine AVIF makes first browsing slower; changing the encoding needs a rebuild.
admin_settings_image_fullsize_hint: Off by default: the viewer reads the preview, which is enough to look at and cheaper to store.
admin_settings_image_raw_embedded: RAW sources use their embedded preview
admin_settings_image_saved: Saved. New uploads derive at the new settings; existing derivatives are untouched.
admin_settings_image_consequence: Saving recomputes nothing — the derivatives already on disk stay as they are. To re-derive at the new settings, ask for the rebuild below.
admin_settings_image_library_line: {count} images in the library · a full rebuild takes about {minutes} min
admin_settings_image_summary_error: The cost line could not be read.
admin_rebuild_scope_missing_note: Skips the derivatives already on disk
admin_rebuild_scope_all_note: Re-derives all {count} images at the saved settings · about {minutes} minutes (NAS) · the CPU belongs to it while it runs
admin_rebuild_scope_all_note_unavailable: The library count is unavailable right now; the full rebuild re-derives every image at the saved settings
admin_rebuild_warning: Browsing is slower while it runs; pause or stop it from the jobs page.
admin_rebuild_started: Rebuild started. Watch it on the jobs page.
admin_rebuild_failed: The rebuild could not be started.
admin_models_contract_wipe: A dimension change wipes this slot's existing embeddings, and it cannot be undone.
admin_models_contract_detect: A detector change re-runs detection and re-aligns the faces.
admin_models_contract_recognize: A recognizer change re-runs the embeddings; named people keep their names.
admin_models_contract_ocr: A recognizer change re-runs text recognition over the library.
admin_models_remove_active_warning: {name} is in use. Removing it falls back to the official default and re-runs the slot.
admin_models_import_hint: added ones join the list above
admin_models_import_file_hint: Drop an .onnx file here, or click to choose
admin_models_import_file_bound: Up to 2 GB · ONNX only (the content decides, not the name)
admin_models_probe_warn_detail: This host is not on the download sources list; the use is logged.
admin_models_probe_expired: The check expired; run it again.
admin_models_trust: Only download sources you trust; model files load in the inference process. Custom URLs are not bound by the download sources list.
admin_models_state_failed_note: The last download failed. Try again; the source chain may recover it.
admin_models_card_empty: No model fills this slot yet.
admin_models_card_not_downloaded_note: The image carries no weights; the first use downloads it.
admin_models_sources_intro: The model download only travels the hosts below.
admin_models_sources_warning: Custom URLs are not bound by this list, but their use is logged — that is your own call.
admin_models_sources_fineprint: Every download hop's host is checked (the upstream can redirect to a CDN), and the file itself is checked against the manifest's sha256 — the hash is the real lock.
model_slot_unknown: No model slot with this name.
model_probe_not_found: The check expired; run it again.
model_probe_required: This source must carry a check that passed.
model_confirm_required: Confirm the wipe of this slot's products first.
model_slot_locked: A switch of this slot is already running.
admin_models_select_chip: Select this model in the list above
viewer_draw_hint: Draw a box around the face · Esc to cancel
viewer_edit_date_note: The zone decides where the photo sits on the timeline, and which day a “years ago today” memory lands on.
viewer_edit_location_note: Search a place name, or click a spot on the map. The photo joins where you pin it.
viewer_edit_location_hint: Drag to move the map · click to drop the pin
viewer_edit_location_no_pin: Click the map or search to pin a location
